title: limonium × pseudoconfusum
intro: Limonium × pseudoconfusum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Statice, is a hybrid plant species in the Plumbaginaceae family, known for its attractive and drought-tolerant foliage. This plant has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, with potential benefits including reduced inflammation and improved air quality. The therapeutic actions of Limonium × pseudoconfusum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to relax muscles and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
